scope: Read-only local six-harness investigation plus Flowspace3 scan of harness-engineering; no adapter implementation or private payload copying.
authority: Unisphere requirements and observed native behavior govern design. harness-engineering is optional inspiration and test material, not authority; its output model, architecture and heuristics need not be copied.

harnesses.name: Codex
harnesses.evidence: 164 rollout paths observed;147 indexed threads;447 records projected from3non-active files spanning3CLI eras. Counts are observed inventory/sample, not a complete product support claim.
harnesses.mapping: Native session/turn/call IDs where present, messages/reasoning/function and custom tool calls; token_count last_token_usage versus cumulative total_token_usage.
hazards: Do not sum repeated cumulative totals or duplicate tool event summaries and call/output pairs.
Header-only identity is not present on every later batch; preserve source identity and optional native IDs without filename-derived facts disguised as native.
Indexes incomplete; date-tree discovery belongs to loader.
harnesses.readiness: Independent pure source-event mapper ready once shared contract lands. Existing explicit-file framing fits; automatic discovery needs bounded date-tree traversal.

harnesses.name: Oh My Pi
harnesses.evidence: 22files in three scoped non-Unisphere directories; installed/current source plus prior sanitized193record fixture; earlier98file title-slot survey was NOT rerun.
harnesses.format: 256byte mutable title slot, v3 session header, append/tree entry journal.
harnesses.mapping: Messages, toolCall/toolResult, native usage/model/provider, parentId branches, compaction/custom records and explicit source events.
hazards: OMP differs from Pi: fixed mutable title prefix, extra entry kinds and blob/artifact references.
Append-only cursor misses in-place retitle; retain limitation or add loader-owned metadata refresh.
No implicit sidecar traversal; preserve unresolved references.
Full current-session reconstruction/header enrichment needs a separate explicit context/state contract, not a mandatory dependency for basic source-event export.
harnesses.readiness: Independent mapper ready with declared title-refresh and sidecar limitations; share framing rather than pretend wire-identical Pi.

harnesses.name: Pi
harnesses.evidence: 945files with v3 session headers observed; installed @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent0.83.0 format and migration source inspected.
harnesses.format: Ordinary header-first v3 JSONL tree; no OMP256byte title prefix.
harnesses.mapping: Messages/model/provider/usage/tool records, branches, compaction, labels, session_info and custom/custom_message distinctions.
hazards: Do not count compaction summaries/custom extension state as ordinary model turns.
Migration and repair can rewrite files; current byte/inode cursor has truncate-and-regrow ceiling.
Pi and OMP share concepts, not an assumed single dialect.
harnesses.readiness: Independent pure Pi mapper ready; common helpers only where actual behavior agrees.

harnesses.name: Copilot CLI
harnesses.evidence: 1988session directories,1720events streams;24inactive streams/4211records projected;4legacy monolithic files. Parent inspected supervised probe logs.
harnesses.format: type/id/parentId/timestamp/data event JSONL; legacy sessionId/startTime/chatMessages/timeline snapshots are separate.
harnesses.mapping: Session/context changes, message/turn/tool lifecycle, native model/usage checkpoints/shutdown and agent/subagent lineage.
hazards: Global session-store.db is a derived/incomplete index, not full event authority.
Usage observations have different scopes; do not aggregate overlapping message/checkpoint/shutdown values blindly.
Legacy snapshot and artifact loading are separate storage scopes.
harnesses.readiness: Current JSONL pure mapper ready independently; legacy snapshot support later or parallel behind snapshot contract.
evidence_refs: Supervised process copilot-struct-probe: actual exited-process logs inspected through hub logs
Supervised process copilot-store-counts: actual exited-process logs inspected through hub logs

harnesses.name: VS Code Copilot
harnesses.evidence: >=200JSON snapshots and17JSONL files observed;3newest snapshots were empty; one391530byte v3 snapshot has5requests and serialized tool activity.100journal lines:kind0=1,kind1=79,kind2=20.
harnesses.format: Two persisted forms, chronology unproven: v3 whole-session JSON snapshots and numeric-kind/path/value mutation journals. JSONL here is NOT one line per chat event.
harnesses.mapping: Populated snapshot has native session/request/response IDs, integer times, modelId, toolInvocationSerialized and edit/undo parts; usage not established by this probe.
hazards: Need versioned patch-journal reconstruction, not direct patch-to-message export. Exact kind1/kind2 semantics remain unverified.
Snapshot files exceed current1MiB default; bounded whole-document policy must be explicit.
Editing sidecars contain file snapshots; do not ingest automatically.
Copilot SQLite cache has flattened turn text and incomplete tool-turn links; existing fixture projection is not full transcript coverage.
harnesses.readiness: Pure snapshot mapper can be developed in parallel against frozen logical input fixtures; end-to-end requires snapshot/reducer loader contract.

harnesses.name: Cursor
harnesses.format: Distinct transcript JSONL, IDE SQLite composer/header/bubble snapshots, and mixedJSON/binary CLIblob storage.
harnesses.mapping: IDE JSON samples expose composerId,bubbleId,requestId,createdAt,modelInfo,tokenCount/toolResults and branch/context structures; keys alone do not establish all counter semantics.
hazards: conversation-search.db is derived FTS/cache, not message truth.
Mutable composer/branch/bubble rows need consistent snapshot identity and revision semantics, not fabricated byte offsets.
CLIopaque blobs remain undecoded; no complete blob-store support claim.
Transcript timestamps/usage may be absent; no invented wallclock event timestamps.
harnesses.readiness: Transcript mapper ready with absence caveats; IDE mapper parallel after snapshot contract. Blob codec is separate follow-on work.

scaffold.current_contract: SessionLoader owns list_sessions/read_batch; current NativeRecord/ReadCursor semantics are LFbyteoffset + Unixdevice/inode. SessionAdapter::map is pure and stateless. Collector<L,A,W> already injects loader, mapper and output.
preserve: One shared source-record output and OTLPwriter
Determinism, explicit provenance, contentopt-in and unknown-field diagnostics
scaffold.needed_for_bulk_jsonl: Bounded harness-specific discovery layouts; explicit file export can use existing framing before recursive discovery is added.
scaffold.needed_for_ide: Explicit snapshot/logical session identity and revision checkpoint; VSCodepatch reducer state; consistent readonlySQLite reads. Do not fake LFbyteoffsets or force snapshots into existing LoadedBatch.validate invariants.
scaffold.parallel_recommendation: Five independent JSONL mapping lanes:Codex,OMP,Pi,CopilotCLI,Cursortranscripts. In parallel define one narrow snapshot/query loader contract enabling separate VSCodeCopilot and CursorIDE mapping lanes. Claude work need not pause; worker fences stay adapter+registration+fixtures.

harness_engineering_reference.method: Actual Flowspace3 scoped code/doc searches and get/tree reads in indexed harness-engineering checkout, with direct local source/fixture metadata checks. Automated ask produced only partial evidence and no synthesized answer; conclusions below are from direct reads.
harness_engineering_reference.providers: Real Azure embedding provider observed; conversation polling degraded, but this scan excluded conversations.
optional_code_reuse: harness/cli/src/services/telemetry/codex-ledger.ts::extractCodexLedger: last native cumulative snapshot; not a general event mapper
harness/cli/src/services/telemetry/adapters/cursor-adapter.ts::readBubbleTimeline: keyprefix,type1user/type2assistant,modelName/time field examples; mixes DB I/O and policy, so not copied wholesale
harness/cli/src/services/telemetry/fixture-extract.ts::projectCopilotVscodeRows: reduced counts-only SQL projection; not rich snapshot decoder
fixture_caveats: Real fixture README says scrubbed paths/identity/secrets but prompts/toolcalls intentionally retained; no new privacy audit performed here.
meta.json scrub attestation and human-reviewed invariants are useful provenance, not proof of all current native variants.
VSCode raw.rows omit message text and do not cover rich snapshots/patchjournal; Cursorfixtures have timing/model gaps for headlessCLI.
Do not copy expected-segment.json as Unisphere OTLP oracle: it pins a different product/output contract.
reject_as_defaults: Invented or anchored/interval event timestamps as native timestamps
Silent null/zero defaults replacing explicit unknown/unsupported semantics
Whole adapter architecture containing environment/FS/DB access
